text.content:
A room whose purpose is impossible to guess under the damage - something dangerous has clearly made a habit of passing through, and the floor itself has suffered for it: cracked, sagging in patches, unconvincing underfoot.

GM Notes

Hazard: The floor here is unstable and gives way under careless weight (DC 13 to notice before stepping wrong). A fall isn't fatal - the drop is short and the debris below is mostly old fleece - but it's loud, and loud carries in this warren.
